next.reason: Both make 9x an implementor-defined unsuccessful condition with x defined by the implementor (§2023:9.1.13.11 GR1; DOC-A.1-110 lists the value of x). 1985 'must not duplicate any condition specified by the I-O status values 00 through 49' (§1985:VII.1.3.5) and 2023 'This condition shall not duplicate any other condition specified by another I-O status value' (§2023:9.1.13.11 GR1) differ only by the 0x and 5x-7x values 2023 adds for new features. For a 1985 program the meaning is the same.
